summary: Writes POP contents to Alembic .abc files, including points, triangle/quad meshes, line strips, lines, built-in attributes, selected custom attributes, and multi-frame animated output. Multiple POPs can be exported as separate Alembic objects.

key_concepts: Alembic Out POP writes POP points, vertices, primitives, multi-frame animation, built-in attributes, and selected custom attributes into an Alembic .abc file.
Each input sequence block exports one POP as a separate Alembic object, but that input must contain exactly one supported primitive type.
Point primitives are written as OPoints, triangle and quad primitives as OPolyMesh, and line/line-strip primitives as linear OCurves with repeated endpoints for closed strips.
Built-in Color, N, and Tex attributes receive Alembic names and handling; custom point, vertex, and primitive attributes are controlled by per-input pattern parameters.
Recording controls cover unique suffixes, length limits, pause/add-frame workflows, maximum active saves, and unchanged topology optimization.
common_gotchas: Each exported input must contain one primitive type; mixed triangles, lines, and points need separate POPs or cleanup.
Alembic uses reversed primitive winding compared with TouchDesigner, so vertex order is flipped when writing and reading.
POP groups are ignored by Alembic Out POP; encode needed grouping as attributes before export.
